\[
d=Y^-,\quad e=X^-,\quad f=Y^+,\quad g=Z^-,\quad h=X^+,\quad i=Y^-,\quad j=X^-.
\]

\[
(d,e)=(Y^-,X^-).
\]
The edge \(x\) is \(ij\), whose endpoints are

(i,j)=(Y^-,X^-).
